rows.grounds: genitive singular of ya; indicates the possessor or source whose seeing is meant
compound of vīkṣaṇa and mātra; instrumental singular neuter expressing means
present middle plural of jan; states that the sadhana come into being
nominative plural neuter of sādhana; subject of jāyante
ablative singular masculine of krama; indicates sequence or order

items.question: By whose mere seeing do sadhana arise in order?
items.inference: The verse states that mere seeing of that being causes sadhana to arise in sequence.
uncertainties: The exact referent of yasya is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: By whose mere seeing, the sadhana arise in order.
